text: The project is under implementation with targets including 250 engineering structures and comprehensive early warning systems rollout. It aims to cover over 7 million people in the Gilgit-Baltistan and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa regions. Annual Performance Reports from 2017 to 2023 indicate ongoing construction, equipment installation, and policy enhancements.

metadata.solution_name: Scaling-up of Glacial Lake Outburst Flood (GLOF) Risk Reduction in Northern Pakistan (GLOF-II)
